data_description.dataset_name: MODIS Thermal Anomalies and Fire Daily Global 1km

spatial_coverage.region_name: Global active fire and thermal anomaly detection coverage
spatial_coverage.coverage: Global daily thermal anomalies and active fire locations from MODIS Terra and Aqua satellites at 1km resolution.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Daily time series from November 2000 (Terra) and July 2002 (Aqua) to present.

analytical_capabilities: Active fire detection and fire spread monitoring
Biomass burning and wildfire intensity assessment
Climate extreme events (drought, heatwave) and fire risk correlation
Fire radiative power and energy release quantification
Burned area mapping and post-fire recovery studies
Smoke emissions and air quality impact assessment

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Fire radiative power (MW) for detected thermal anomalies; includes FireMask confidence levels (low/nominal/high) and MaxFRP (maximum fire radiative power); confirm runtime band units and detection thresholds before numeric comparison.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Product provides daily fire detections with confidence flags; fire pixels indicate active combustion or high-temperature thermal anomalies; quality flags indicate cloud cover and other retrieval conditions.

data_description.data_source: NASA MODIS Collection 6.1 Thermal Anomalies and Fire Product via Google Earth Engine
